case: 3D classical cantilever SIMP topology-layout optimization with static MPM equilibrium
scope: A bounded-iteration continuous material-layout demonstration. It is not a converged optimum or certified manufacturable binary part.

design.fixed_end: left face clamped; two x-cell layers are non-design material
design.load: 100 N resultant on a finite non-design central pad at the right end; same resultant and moment in every solve
design.field: 3,612 design voxel densities on a fixed 3D material-point lattice
design.optimizer: JAX value_and_grad with implicit custom_linear_solve derivative; quadratic B-spline MPM gradients; SIMP p=3 and residual modulus 0.001E; radius-2-cell Gaussian density filter; projection beta 1.5, 3, 6, 12; volume fraction target 0.38

strict_zero_void_audit.method: SciPy sparse LU with exact symmetric diagonal equilibration of thresholded MPM stiffness

scaled_vs_unscaled_active_particle_displ.interpretation: the raw unscaled LU is numerically contaminated by weak cavity degrees of freedom; symmetric diagonal equilibration is an algebraically equivalent solve and gives a lower, physically plausible active-particle displacement. Keep both raw runs; use only the equilibrated solution for physical interpretation.

strict_zero_void_audit.weak_node_caveat: The exact zero-void operator has very weak cavity DOFs. The largest equilibrated nodal value is 0.488 m at a low-support non-material cavity node; the maximum interpolated displacement at active material quadrature points is 24.3 micrometres. Do not visualize the nodal field as physical deformation. An unscaled sparse LU produced a numerically contaminated active-particle field and is preserved as a failed diagnostic.
strict_zero_void_audit.interpretation: The equilibrated LU has a tiny residual and force/moment errors, but exact-zero-void active-particle displacement changes materially under alternate sparse ordering and disagrees with scaled CG; therefore no zero-void solution is accepted as physically stable. Affine weak-node aggregation is a separate modified-discrete-space diagnostic, not an equivalent solution.
strict_zero_void_audit.scaled_cg_status: not_converged; relative residual 3.395e-6 after 12000 iterations, above 1e-8 gate

visuals.phi035_initial_note: The initial projected field is below phi=0.35 through the design region, so that view shows only the clamp and load pads; optimization density is gradually drawn through the same continuous field.
visuals.binary_surface_note: Direct exposed faces of the 0/1 thresholded rho_binary cells, no point interpolation or contour smoothing. The underlying thresholded solve still used 0.001E ersatz void; this view is not a zero-void physical certification.

limitations: 48 accepted updates only; no convergence claim.
The SIMP optimizer and the phi=.50 binary equilibrium solve use residual modulus 0.001E.
The independent zero-void audit uses SciPy sparse LU with symmetric diagonal equilibration, not JAX; weak non-material cavity nodes remain ill-conditioned.
The density filter and voxel section counts do not certify a minimum manufacturable feature size.
The physical material is an illustrative isotropic aluminum parameter assumption, not a validated production alloy model.

The exact zero-void field is solver-order sensitive despite small direct-solve residuals; affine weak-node aggregation changes the discrete space and is diagnostic only. No zero-void physical stability claim is made.
